description: Successful operation_result after the host unwraps the SDK result envelope. Matching is identification evidence only, never permission. Refusals remain host-visible errors, not instances of this success schema.

recovery.description: Discovery, not permission: incompatible/corrupt stores are NOT an empty speaker list. Copy only the two observed hash fields into speaker.reset.recovery after closing speech; the host asks for confirmation.

session_open.description: Whether an ordinary speech session is open. A durable capture_id never requires it; live-final selection does.

policy_sha256.description: The policy actually governing the stored enrollment and its readiness decisions.

runtime_policy_sha256.description: The policy for new guided enrollment; not silently applied to existing profiles.

policy_upgrade_required.description: If true, close speech and propose speaker.upgrade_policy before enrolling a durable capture. Existing speakers still use their stored bound policy.

revision.description: Opaque decimal revision; never convert through a floating-point number.

publication.description: The engine's publication/readback evidence on a modifying operation.
